summary: Fixed the pre-push version-bump advisory to diff against the commit git is actually pushing instead of the local checkout's HEAD.
root_cause: scripts/hooks/pre-push always invoked the version-bump guard with --head-ref HEAD, so when the pushed branch's tip differed from the currently checked-out HEAD (e.g. a commit built via plumbing while HEAD stayed on another branch), the advisory diffed HEAD against the base and reported changed_files=0 even though the push added files.
fix: The hook now reads the pre-push stdin protocol (local-ref local-sha1 remote-ref remote-sha1) up front, before any other step can consume stdin, extracts the first non-empty non-all-zero local-sha1 (the commit git says is actually being pushed), and uses it as --head-ref for the version-bump guard invocation, falling back to HEAD only when no pushed sha is available.

regression_test.description: Builds a target git repo with an origin/main tracking ref configured, constructs a commit via git plumbing (hash-object, mktree, commit-tree, update-ref) that adds a file on refs/heads/feature while HEAD stays on main at the base commit, then invokes scripts/hooks/pre-push with a pre-push stdin protocol line for the feature ref and asserts the advisory reports changed_files=1 and lists the added file rather than changed_files=0.
regression_test.oracle: Independent of the implementation under test: asserts on the hook's own advisory output text against the scenario described in the reproduction steps, not on internal implementation details.
regression_test.sensitivity_check: With the fix applied, all 5 tests (4 pre-existing plus the new one) pass. The head-ref selection was then temporarily reverted to a hardcoded HEAD (keeping the new stdin-reading code in place) and the suite rerun: the new regression test failed with changed_files=0 while the 4 pre-existing tests still passed. The fix was then restored; its write receipt sha256 matched the pre-revert write exactly, and the full suite passed again.

test_results.after_fix: test: 5 passed. reproduce reported verdict=PASS, changed_files=1, with the added file listed in the advisory output.
test_results.with_defect_reintroduced: test: 1 failed (the new regression test only), 4 passed (pre-existing tests unaffected).

scope: Change is confined to the version-bump advisory's ref-selection logic in scripts/hooks/pre-push. No changes were made to the runtime-governance smoke step, CI workflows, gates, enforcement, or any consumer repository.
limitations: If a single push delivers multiple refs, the hook selects the first non-deleted ref's local sha from stdin, matching its pre-existing behavior of running the advisory once per invocation rather than once per ref. Lines whose local-sha is all zeros (ref deletion) are skipped when selecting the pushed commit.
